intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre lost property.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about lost property.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: A blue backpack was found near Room 4 after the English class. It has a small yellow star on the front and a name tag inside. The owner can collect it from the school office before four o’clock today. Please bring your student card. If nobody collects it today, the office will keep it until Friday.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: A blue backpack was found near Room 4 after the English class. It has a small yellow star on the front and a name tag inside. The owner can collect it from the school office before four o’clock today. Please bring your student card. If nobody collects it today, the office will keep it until Friday.
